statements.impact_statement: CVE-2025-14104 is a heap buffer over-read in setpwnam() in util-linux when it writes a 256-byte user name to the password file (https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/issues/3585, fixed by commits aaa9e718c88d6916b003da7ebcfe38a3c88df8e6 and 9a36d77012c4c771f8d51eba46b6e62c29bf572a). setpwnam() is compiled only into chfn and chsh: login-utils/setpwnam.c is listed only in their sources, and vipw includes only the setpwnam.h header. We checked the file lists of all 38 binary packages built from the util-linux source for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI repository (util-linux, util-linux-login, util-linux-misc, mount, the libraries and the -dev, -static, -doc, -openrc and bash-completion packages among them), in each published build, 2.41.2-r0, 2.41.4-r0, 2.41.6-r0 and 2.41.6-r1, for x86_64 and aarch64, after verifying each against its index checksum. None contains chfn, chsh or a setpwnam file; Alpine builds util-linux with --disable-chfn-chsh and ships those programs from the shadow package instead (https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/util-linux/APKBUILD).

CVE-2025-14104 is a heap buffer over-read in setpwnam() in util-linux when it writes a 256-byte user name to the password file (https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/issues/3585, fixed by commits aaa9e718c88d6916b003da7ebcfe38a3c88df8e6 and 9a36d77012c4c771f8d51eba46b6e62c29bf572a). setpwnam() is compiled only into chfn and chsh: login-utils/setpwnam.c is listed only in their sources, and vipw includes only the setpwnam.h header. We checked the file lists of every binary package of every published util-linux build in the DHI Debian repository for amd64 and arm64, 133 package files in all (util-linux-locales is architecture-independent and is listed for both): the current 2.41.5-0+deb13u1 build's packages, including the debug-symbol packages, and the older bsdutils and login rebuilds that are still published, after verifying each against its index checksum. None contains chfn, chsh or a setpwnam file; Debian builds util-linux with --disable-chfn-chsh and ships those programs from the shadow source instead. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-14104.
